name: information-flow
description: 写周记、周记、weekly journal. Lists the week's digest before any journal text. Daily intake and Markdown Cognition stay separate; private cognition stays out of this repo.

interface.longDescription: Pulls Snipd, WeRead, and YouTube likes into weekly intake.md. Journal opens the weekly digest at 📋 Digests/{YYYY-Wnn}/digest.md on its own, shows all three groups in full with item IDs, and discusses by ID; write_journal.py --append-digest saves the full digest as a separate section at the journal end in the same write. Discussion starts from recent journals and old project echoes, not a week dump. Journal writes only after Jake says OK. Cognition (Evidence/Belief/Principle, schema_version 1.1) is a separate Markdown layer in DigitalBrain with a human gate; private cognition is not stored in this repo. Skill copies sync into DigitalBrain.
